_help: Everything specific to one airline lives here. To use another airline, edit this file. The classifier itself is not airline-specific.

reply_templates.Cancelled Flight: Hello, we're sorry your flight was cancelled and for the disruption this has caused. We've passed your message to our {team} team so they can look at your situation. Please send us your booking reference by direct message so they can find you quickly.
reply_templates.Late Flight: Hello, we're sorry your flight was delayed. We've passed your message to our {team} team. Please send us your booking reference by direct message so they can look into it.
reply_templates.Lost Luggage: Hello, we're sorry your bag has not arrived. We've passed your message to our {team} team. Please send us your booking reference and bag tag number by direct message so they can trace it.
reply_templates.Damaged Luggage: Hello, we're sorry your bag was damaged. We've passed your message to our {team} team. Please send us your booking reference and a photo of the damage by direct message.
reply_templates.Flight Booking Problems: Hello, we're sorry you had trouble with your booking. We've passed your message to our {team} team. Please send us your booking reference by direct message so they can look at it.
reply_templates.Customer Service Issue: Hello, we're sorry about your experience with our service. We've passed your message to our {team} team. Please send us your booking reference by direct message so they can follow up.
reply_templates.Flight Attendant Complaints: Hello, we're sorry about your experience on board. We've passed your message to our {team} team. Please send us your flight number and date by direct message so they can follow up.
reply_templates.Bad Flight: Hello, we're sorry your flight was not what you expected. We've passed your message to our {team} team. Please send us your flight number and date by direct message.
reply_templates.longlines: Hello, we're sorry about the long wait. We've passed your message to our {team} team. Please tell us the airport and time by direct message.
reply_templates.Can't Tell: Hello, we're sorry to hear about your experience. We've passed your message to our {team} team. Please tell us more about what happened and your booking reference by direct message.
